messages:
alex: Heads-up — I opened a tiny rename PR on the kvcache branch. CI blocked the merge because gofumpt flagged formatting. Need one more approval for the formatter exemption (it's literally a rename + regenerated files). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kvcache/pull/842
jenna: Can you paste the minimal diff here? if it's just renames + regen I'm fine approving.
alex: Sure, here's the core change (other diffs are generated):
```diff
- type CacheKey struct {
-     User string `json:"user"`
- }
+ type CacheId struct {
+     User string `json:"user"`
+ }
```
alex: Also renamed usages: `kvcache.NewCacheKey` -> `kvcache.NewCacheId` (3 callsites). No semantics changed.
buildbot: CI: presubmit failed — gofumpt check (1/4). Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/12345/logs
maria: quick nit: the proto JSON tag still reads `cacheKey` in generated proto JSON tests — that will break e2e unless regen fixes it. Did you run `make gen`?
alex: Good catch, I missed regenerating the protos. Running `make gen` locally now and will push.
alex: Pushed regen + gofumpt fix. PTAL @jenna @maria
jenna: :thumbsup: LGTM — small rename, tests pass locally for me.
maria: LGTM too after the regen. Please add a one-line changelog note and queue the merge during the 16:00 UTC merge window.
alex: Added changelog entry and updated PR description with the rationale. Will merge 5–10m after CI is green during the window. Thanks all!
